rendererConversionNotes.threeJs: Native match (+Y up, +Z forward, 1 unit = 1 meter). Load directly via GLTFLoader.
rendererConversionNotes.babylonJs: Babylon converts right-handed glTF automatically via __root__ node; use scene.useRightHandedSystem = true for direct socket parity.
rendererConversionNotes.blenderOrZUp: Rotate root +90 deg around X (X-right, Y-forward, Z-up) on import; standard Blender glTF 2.0 importer handles +Y up -> +Z up automatically.

vfxLayerSemantics.vfx_scan_cone: Optional camera imaging frustum cone. Show only when camera is actively scanning inside the imaging window.
vfxLayerSemantics.vfx_downlink_beam: Optional antenna radio link cone/pulses. Show only during ground station pass when bufferMb > 0 and transmitter is active.
vfxLayerSemantics.vfx_thruster_plume: Optional engine exhaust plume. Show only during ignition/thrust maneuvers; keep hidden during passive orbital observation.
vfxLayerSemantics.vfx_heater_glow: Optional subtle amber heater strip indicator on satellite bus. Show only when heater is actively warming in eclipse shadow.
vfxLayerSemantics.vfx_cold_frost: Optional frost crystal overlay when coldStress >= 2 (camera cold-locked).
vfxLayerSemantics.vfx_storm_particles: Optional solar storm plasma ring overlay when storm === true.
